steps.title: Deliver the provenance lock and its single reader
steps.intent: Establish lza.lock at the repository root as the one hand-maintained record of the upstream LZA release and toolchain, plus deploy/scripts/common.sh as the single sourced reader that exposes each key as a shell variable, and CODEOWNERS requiring reviewer approval for the lock and desired-state files. Every downstream script and the workflow read versions only from the lock.
steps.acceptance: lza.lock contains exactly the ten flat keys with the Section 5.1 values; sourcing deploy/scripts/common.sh from the repo root exports LZA_VERSION=v1.16.1, LZA_COMMIT=8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab, CT_LANDING_ZONE_VERSION=4.0, CT_OU_BASELINE_VERSION=5.0; CODEOWNERS assigns a required reviewer to /lza.lock.
steps.stand_in: CODEOWNERS reviewer @sunstonesecure-robert for /lza.lock, /config/**, /control-tower/**, /deployment/schemas/** — carried verbatim from the inputs/lza-phase0 prototype, pending q-codeowners.

steps.title: Deliver the LZA and Control Tower desired-state files and schemas
steps.intent: Deliver the six mandatory LZA config files (config/**), the Control Tower declarations (control-tower/**: landing-zone-manifest.template.json, baselines.yaml, controls.yaml, control-exceptions.yaml, ownership-matrix.yaml), and the deployment materials (deployment/**: inputs.example.yaml, the example state files, and deployment/schemas/**). Every value is rendered to agree with lza.lock; the one permitted second copy of version/commit is the lza block of deployment/inputs.example.yaml.
steps.acceptance: config/ holds exactly the six mandatory files and no customizations-config.yaml; global-config.yaml Control Tower version is "4.0" and baselines.yaml version is "5.0"; the manifest template is valid JSON; deployment/inputs.example.yaml lza.version and lza.commit equal the lock's; all desired-state files validate against deployment/schemas/**.
steps.stand_in: loggingRetentionDays=365 and accessLogRetentionDays=365 (and the mirrored manifest/global-config retentionDays) carried from spec Section 3 example, pending q-retention (IN-009 requires these be approved as cost/compliance decisions, not silently inherited).

steps.title: Deliver the offline validation gate, tests, and workflow at repo-root paths
steps.intent: Deliver deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh (the eight credential-free checks), the Bats suite under tests/*.bats (config, consistency, control-tower-manifest, controls, evidence, ownership, shell), the workflow .github/workflows/lza-phase0_validate-offline.yml with its prototype inputs/lza-phase0/ path prefixes rewritten to repo-root (vendor/lza, build/, root trigger paths), and the supporting root files Makefile, README.md, .gitignore, .editorconfig, .yamllint.yml. The workflow runs read-only with contents: read and clones the pinned upstream into the git-ignored vendor/lza.
steps.acceptance: The workflow file exists with contents: read permissions and no inputs/lza-phase0/ path prefix; deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh is executable and sources common.sh referencing vendor/lza; the no-literal-leak test finds the LZA version, commit, and Yarn literals in no delivered Phase-0 file other than lza.lock and deployment/inputs.example.yaml; the validate job runs all eight offline checks green in CI on the merged commit.

verification_targets.check: lza.lock contains exactly ten flat keys and the pinned literals: version v1.16.1, commit 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab, controlTowerLandingZoneVersion "4.0", controlTowerOuBaselineVersion "5.0".
verification_targets.run: test "$(grep -cE '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*:' lza.lock)" -eq 10 && grep -qxF 'version: v1.16.1' lza.lock && grep -qxF 'commit: 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab' lza.lock && grep -qF 'controlTowerLandingZoneVersion: "4.0"' lza.lock && grep -qF 'controlTowerOuBaselineVersion: "5.0"' lza.lock

verification_targets.check: Sourcing deploy/scripts/common.sh from the repo root exports LZA_VERSION, LZA_COMMIT, CT_LANDING_ZONE_VERSION, and CT_OU_BASELINE_VERSION with the lock's values.
verification_targets.run: . deploy/scripts/common.sh && test "$LZA_VERSION" = v1.16.1 && test "$LZA_COMMIT" = 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab && test "$CT_LANDING_ZONE_VERSION" = 4.0 && test "$CT_OU_BASELINE_VERSION" = 5.0

verification_targets.check: CODEOWNERS assigns at least one required reviewer to /lza.lock.
config/ contains exactly the six mandatory non-empty LZA files and no customizations-config.yaml.
verification_targets.run: for f in accounts global iam network organization security; do test -s config/$f-config.yaml; done && test ! -e config/customizations-config.yaml

verification_targets.check: config/global-config.yaml declares Control Tower landing-zone version "4.0" and control-tower/baselines.yaml declares baseline version "5.0", matching the lock.
deployment/inputs.example.yaml lza.version and lza.commit equal the lock's v1.16.1 and 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab.
The delivered workflow .github/workflows/lza-phase0_validate-offline.yml exists and declares contents: read permissions.
The delivered workflow references repo-root paths and carries no inputs/lza-phase0/ prototype path prefix.
deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh is executable, sources common.sh, and references the vendor/lza checkout.
verification_targets.run: test -x deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh && grep -q 'common.sh' deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh && grep -q 'vendor/lza' deploy/scripts/validate-config-offline.sh

verification_targets.check: No delivered Phase-0 file other than lza.lock and deployment/inputs.example.yaml contains the LZA version, upstream commit, or Yarn version as a literal (REP-014).
verification_targets.run: test -z "$(git grep -I -l -e v1.16.1 -e 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab -e 1.22.22 -- config control-tower deploy tests deployment .github/workflows/lza-phase0_validate-offline.yml ':!lza.lock' ':!deployment/inputs.example.yaml')"

boundary_cases.description: If the cloned upstream resolves v1.16.1^{commit} to any commit other than the lock's, the workflow's checkout-and-verify step (and check 1) fails before any package script runs.
If any delivered Phase-0 file other than lza.lock and deployment/inputs.example.yaml contains the LZA version, commit, or Yarn literal, the consistency test fails the gate (REP-014).

Only the exact declared placeholders are permitted (REPLACE_ME twice in inputs.example.yaml and the three ${...} tokens in the manifest template with their declared counts); any other placeholder token fails check 5.
The version-4.0 landing-zone manifest template carries no organizationStructure block, since landing-zone version 4.0 removed it (CTCFG-007).

The delivered tests/*.bats files are added alongside the pre-existing oversight vitest suite under tests/ (fixtures/, integration/, mocks/, unit/) without overwriting it; the offline gate and `make test-phase0` run only tests/*.bats.
